feeds.description: FITSNews focuses on the ongoing and recent matters and news from the political field, covering local and current affairs in the following section. FITSNews is the brainchild of South Carolina political consultant and former gubernatorial spokesman Will Folks.

feeds.title: Post and Courier » South Carolina Politics
feeds.description: The Post and Courier, South Carolina's largest newspaper and the winner of the 2015 Pulitzer Prize for Public Service cover the issues that matter the most to you. In the South Carolina Politics section get all the latest politics news from South Carolina, including coverage of the Statehouse and SC Legislature in Columbia.

feeds.title: Bradwarthen.com » Elections
feeds.description: Brad Warthen is an ex-newspaperman, turned latter-day Mad Man. He started blogging in 2005 and was immediately addicted. He despises all political parties that actually exist, although he has proposed the creation of several parties of his own - the UnParty and the Energy Party most prominent among them. He is neither a liberal nor a conservative in the ways they are popularly defined these days.
